summary: ARMOUR Residential REIT filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, confirming a routine monthly cash dividend of $0.24 per common share (record October 15, 2026; payable October 29, 2026) and a quarterly Series C preferred rate of $0.14583 per share monthly for October, November, and December 2026. The common dividend is consistent with guidance released September 24, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, stake, or transaction terms are involved. This is an ordinary dividend declaration, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
